items.quote: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
items.claim: Abraham set seven ewe lambs by themselves

items.quote: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
items.claim: Abimelech questioned Abraham about the meaning of the seven ewe lambs

items.quote: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
items.claim: Abraham affirms having dug a well
